title: if you trade from outside the US, what's still actually broken in 2026
author: Cute-Complaint-106
selftext:
Genuine question for the sub. For people trading US equities from outside the US, what's still bad in your workflow in 2026?

Asking because we've been building for this bucket. Tokenized US stocks and commodities, USDC settle, 24/7, backed 1:1 at Alpaca and IBKR, in beta. platform: [gm.markets](http://gm.markets) 

More interested in "what's broken" answer than pushing app though. Fire away.
